As expected, thinking things through logically wasn't exactly her strong suit,
making training quite an uphill battle.

It was true that Winning Ticket's earnest, all-or-nothing nature
might currently be her greatest weakness. However—

Could it be... Could it be that...
this habit of mine is actually super bad?!

In other words, what Winning Ticket needed to develop right now
was the ability to judge when to exert her power—namely, "tactical pacing."

Starting today! Let's get down to training!!
I'm in your caaaare!!
OOOOH! What is it, what is it?!

I'm always giving it my all, sure, but... somehow,
I feel like my "all-out" has gotten way, way bigger!!
Stu... dying...?

'Cause Trainer, you really mean it, right?!
—That we're gonna win the Derby together!

So, I wrote down what I thought might work,
and I want you to look at it right now!!
Really!?

Being able to pour her heart and soul into running without hesitation
could become an unstoppable weapon, once she learns how to channel it.

Yeah!! I'll put everything I've got into any workout,
so bring on whatever you've got!!

According to the materials I received from the academy instructor
who oversees group training for umamusume without trainers—

T-Trainer!?
You're really lost in thought! Are you okay!?

Before jumping into serious training, I want to
get to know her well and clearly grasp where she currently stands.

Though in the Debut selection race, I got caught up
in the heat around me and wound up taking 5th place...

Huh, wait?
Is 20 seconds at this mark slow? Or fast?

Sorry, let me try one more time!!
Heeeeeere I goooooo!!
...Surely, probably, absolutely!
However...

Man, that story was sooo good, waaaah!! Like in episode 1 when
Umako picks up that carrot the little girl dropped, it just...!!

Yeah!! I can feel it crystal clear,
how much you've believed in that all along!!

Knowing that you believe in me, Trainer... Just that alone
makes me feel way, way more power surging than ever before!
Whaaaaat!?

Aaaaargh, people told me that all the time!!
I just could never seem to fix it, though...

My time...? Haaah!?
T-That's right, I completely forgooooot!!

G-Gwaaaahhhhh!?
Whaaaat the heeeeeck!?

U-Uwooooh!!
I don't get it at aaaaaall!!

Trainer, how was that?
I ran with absolutely everything I had!!

Is that really true, though?
Felt totally normal to me.
It's pretty late, though... is it okay?

...Aaaahhhhhh!
Now that you mention it!

Oh, but didn't you want to talk before we started working out?
What is it? What are we gonna talk about?
If it's her, I know she can grow...!
What else!? What... what else...!?
Of course I will!!

...From that point on, our arduous days together
had officially begun.

Really!?
A weapon... Wow, is that true...!!

Doryaryaryaaaaah!!
...Phew!!

Knock-knock-knock!
Excuse meeeeee!!

Come to think of it, the instructor at the academy always told me,
"You wear your heart on your sleeve way too much."

That's the one with Umako as the main character, right!? I know it, I know it!
I watched the anime!! And read the novel in our school textbook!
So, with that being said... Let's do this, please!!

*sniff*... *sob*... Umakoooooo!!
You're such a good giiiirl!!

Uwaaaah!! Making my own trainer worry like this,
what kind of person am I... What is wrong with meeee?!
Gaaaaaaaasp!?

Ah! I haven't trained enough!!
But if I give it everything, it'll work out!! Time to train, train, traaaain!!

Everyone gets so fired up in races, right? When that intensity
and that "UWOOOOH!" feeling hits me, I just can't help it...!!
Finish in one minute... Finish in one minute...!

Progress was certainly slow going, but Winning Ticket tackled every single thing
with all her might, and the potential for real growth was undeniably there.

Trainer, how was it?
My notebook!!

Ummm, the reason the heavy favorite couldn't win
in that last race was...

Trainer!
I watched a ton of race footage from the tapes you lent me yesterday!
